2203. Finding the Factorial of a Number Using Recursion

60

Medium

Problem Statement
Read an integer and print its factorial using a recursive function.

Description
The factorial of n, written n!, is the product of all integers from 1 to n, and the factorial of 0 is 1. Read an integer n from input. Write a recursive function factorial that takes an integer parameter. If n is 0, the function returns 1 (this is the base case). Otherwise, it returns n multiplied by the result of calling itself with n - 1. Call the function from main() and print the result. No loop should be used.
input_spec:
. Write a recursive function factorial that takes an integer parameter. If n is 0, the function returns 1 (this is the base case). Otherwise, it returns n multiplied by the result of calling itself with n - 1. Call the function from main() and print the result. No loop should be used.

Input Description
A single integer n (0 <= n <= 10).
